shareholders.evidence: We must continuously achieve superior financial and operating results

integrity.evidence: Our commitment to high ethical standards, compliance and integrity

safety.evidence: our safety and environmental policies and practices

innovation.evidence: uses technology and innovation to help meet the world’s growing energy needs

result.analyst_notes: Factual, corporate tone, leading with scale, market position and history rather than values. Shareholder results and ethical standards are the only stated commitments, framed in first-person plural with absolute wording ('must', 'commitment'). Customers, employees, communities and environment receive no commitments. Ethics appears twice, and safety appears only as a passing reference within the ethics sentence.
